title: TMPlayer Music 0.1.0
summary: The first stable release: a player for the audio files already in your own Telegram chats, for Android 6.0 and newer.
highlights: Home with a Speed dial grid of the tracks you come back to, and the position you stopped at.
A bottom bar with Home, Chats and Library, and a rail in landscape.
Sign in with a phone number and code, or with a QR code that renews, expires and shows a tick when scanned.
Tracks, albums and playlists with no picture get a generated cover.
A lyrics page, with a switch in Settings for the online lookup.
Haptic feedback on play, pause, skip, shuffle, repeat, the seek bar and the queue.
Update now in Settings for the APK from GitHub: it checks the download is signed with the same key, then Android asks you to confirm.
One pure black look. Licence GPL-3.0-or-later with an OpenSSL exception.
